voices.note: ת"ר at Sukkah.3a.13-3b.1: the house without four by four amot
the Gemara's voice: אמר מר, מאי טעמא, the inferences, proofs, objections and emendations
דתנן at 3b.5: עירובי חצרות בחצר ושיתופי מבוי במבוי (Eruvin 85b)
והתנן at 3b.6: הנותן עירובו בבית שער אכסדרה ומרפסת (Eruvin 72b)
והתנן at 3b.10: אין חולקין את החצר (Bava Batra 11a)

props.gloss_en: a house without four by four amot is exempt from mezuza and parapet, does not become impure with plagues, is not sold irrevocably as a walled-city house, and one does not return from the battle lines for it
and one does not make an eruv [of courtyards] for it, nor a shituf [of alleyways]
and one does not place an eruv in it
and one does not make it an extension [ibur] between two towns
and brothers and partners do not divide it
what is the reason? because 'house' is written in all of them
what is the reason [for the eruv clauses]? because it is not fit for dwelling
an eruv of courtyards one does not place in it, but a shituf [of the alleyway] one does place in it
what is the reason? because it is no worse than a courtyard in the alleyway
the eruv of courtyards [is placed] in the courtyard, the shituf of the alleyway in the alleyway
one who places his eruv in a gatehouse, a portico or a balcony -- it is no eruv; and one who lives there does not prohibit [the courtyard]
rather say: the eruv of courtyards [is placed] in a house in the courtyard, and the shituf of alleyways in a courtyard in the alleyway
for we do not treat it even like watchmen's huts [burganin]
what is the reason? watchmen's huts are fit for their purpose, and this is not fit for its purpose
the reason is that it lacks four amot; but if it has four amot, they divide it
one does not divide the courtyard unless it has four amot for this one and four amot for that one
rather say: it has no law of division like a courtyard
Rav Huna: a courtyard is divided according to its entrances
Rav Chisda: one gives four amot for each entrance, and the rest they divide equally
that applies to a house which stands to endure -- we give it courtyard; this, which stands to be torn down -- we do not give it courtyard

supports.gloss_en: read from the baraita's wording: it says one does not place an 'eruv' in it -- the eruv of courtyards, not the shituf
דתנן: עירובי חצרות בחצר, שיתופי מבוי במבוי -- the shituf goes in a courtyard of the alleyway
והאי לא גרע מחצר שבמבוי -- on the emended mishnah, the shituf goes in a courtyard of the alleyway, and this house is no worse
דאמר רב הונא: חצר לפי פתחיה מתחלקת
ורב חסדא אמר: נותן לכל פתח ופתח ארבע אמות
